styles.notes: Source-page example E07141664 (year 07 -> 2007). Page 1-based positions 2nd & 3rd numerical digits = year, converted to 0-based half-open [1,3]. Character counting verified: [1,3] = '07' -> 2007; digit-only counting would give '71' and is not the page's reading (the page marks the prefix E07). Month is the 1st character (letter) per page text, but its letter-to-month mapping is chart-only in image Champion_Essick-Air_Spec-Air-Serial-Number-Style-1_How-to-determine-the-date-of-manufacture-or-age.png, so month is null and the style ships year-only.
